title_zh: 轻体验城市：应景 AI 与体验权协议
title_en: Light-Experience City: Moment-Specific AI and Experience Rights Protocol
scope_note_zh: 本文件定义设计建议和试点审查字段，不声称现有城市系统、交通运营方或商户已经实施这些能力。
scope_note_en: This file defines design proposals and pilot-review fields. It does not claim that current city systems, transport operators, or merchants have implemented them.

system_rules.requirement: No service starts without an explicit user or authorised staff trigger.
Data from one task is not linked to another scene unless the user makes a separate, specific choice.
Use the smallest current-context input needed for the requested answer, preferring edge processing or anonymous aggregates.
Declare retention before use and erase temporary location, preference, and interaction data when the session ends.
State why an option appears and visibly distinguish sponsored or commercial placement from public-service information.
Declining data access must not reduce access to basic mobility, dining, shopping, public space, or staffed service.
Signs, timetables, price boards, staffed windows, and ordinary ticketing remain usable without sensors or recommendations.

scenario_cards.host_space: Zhongzhiyuan Stack Yard supervised test court
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Declared test task and reviewed prompts; no visitor identity
scenario_cards.retention: Raw test material follows the declared review plan; only redacted summaries become public
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: Staffed explanation and printed test summary
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Unexplained data processing, unsafe output, or missing reviewer

scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: User begins a supervised device demonstration
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Device test signal only; no persistent visitor identifier
scenario_cards.retention: Session diagnostics deleted or de-identified under the posted test plan
scenario_cards.public_return: Accessible demonstration hours and test notes
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Undisclosed capture, unsafe hardware, or unavailable steward

scenario_cards.minimum_data: Attendance capacity and voluntarily supplied contribution
scenario_cards.retention: Named attribution only with separate consent; otherwise aggregate participation
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Closed participation, unclear licence, or missing facilitator

scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: User taps or asks for an explanation
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Unverified performance claim or unavailable source

scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: Creator submits a release for hosted review
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Release files, licence, and accountable contact
scenario_cards.retention: Published material follows its declared open licence
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: In-person release briefing and printed access guide
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Missing licence, attribution, or accountable contact

scenario_cards.host_space: AI Origin Community shared service desk
scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: Team requests a specific transfer service
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Declared project need and contact for the current case
scenario_cards.retention: Case record follows a posted service-retention rule

scenario_cards.minimum_data: Capacity count; accessibility request only when supplied
scenario_cards.retention: Anonymous attendance aggregate; no learning profile
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Inaccessible delivery, undisclosed recording, or absent host

scenario_cards.title_zh: 知识产权与数据合规门诊
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Facts needed for the stated question
scenario_cards.retention: No model training; case retention set by the responsible professional
scenario_cards.public_return: Reusable public checklist without case details
scenario_cards.stop_condition: No qualified professional or risk of exposing confidential data

scenario_cards.host_space: Stations, exchange spurs, and blue-green stops
scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: Scan, tap, spoken question, or explicit device request
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Current origin, destination, service status, and chosen accessibility needs
scenario_cards.retention: Temporary location and preference data erased at session end
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: Signs, timetables, accessible route map, and staff
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Continuous tracking, face recognition, unexplained route, or missing fallback

scenario_cards.host_space: Dazhongsi Market Yard and participating street interfaces
scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: User asks for a meal or merchant option
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Current area, time, price range, dietary constraint, and accessibility choice
scenario_cards.retention: Temporary request and preference data erased at session end
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: Visible menus, price boards, maps, and staffed inquiry
scenario_cards.public_return: Distance, wait, price, dietary, and accessibility comparison
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Undisclosed sponsorship, false availability, cross-scene profiling, or no complaint path

scenario_cards.title_zh: 购物比价·维修·退换助手
scenario_cards.host_space: Dazhongsi Market Yard and participating retail interfaces
scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: User asks about a product or after-sales need
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Current area, product need, price range, repair or return request, and accessibility choice
scenario_cards.retention: Temporary request data erased at session end; no shopping profile
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: Price labels, receipt rules, repair desk, and staffed service
scenario_cards.public_return: Explainable comparison of price, repair, return, and access
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Hidden advertising, discriminatory ranking, persistent profile, or unavailable human service

scenario_cards.title_zh: 公共安全与内容复核台
scenario_cards.host_space: Dazhongsi staffed review desk and event interfaces
scenario_cards.voluntary_trigger: Authorised staff review or a user complaint
scenario_cards.minimum_data: Aggregate capacity, equipment status, and necessary incident report
scenario_cards.retention: Retention follows the declared legal and safety basis; no commercial profiling
scenario_cards.non_digital_fallback: Staff decision, posted capacity, and physical complaint channel
scenario_cards.public_return: Correctable decision record and accessible content
scenario_cards.stop_condition: Automated enforcement, missing legal basis, inaccessible content, or absent reviewer
